Maui’s Hana Coast Rainforest, the road to Hana and spectacular Haleakala awaits you. With your shore excursion group, come and explore the Valley Isle during your voyage to Maui. Temptation Tours’ adventure packages are sure to open your heart to the real Hawai’i, the Hawai’i our ancestors soon called home.
